§cA SPENT BUNDLE IS MOSTLY STILL URANIUM.§r
PUREX is the good way to reprocess it. The §9Centrifuge recipes§r for spent rods and bundles always work, so your spent fuel is never stranded. The Canyon is what you build to get §1far more§r back out of the same bundle.

§5THE CRUDE ROUTE§r §8- plain Centrifuge, EV to LuV§r
 §2 1x Depleted Fuel Assembly  ->  Uranium + Plutonium + Lead dust§r §8(+ Platinum foil, or Thorium / Naquadah on the bonded grades), 60 s§r
 §2 1x Depleted Fuel Rod  ->  a third of that§r §8(20 s)§r
§cWhat it does NOT give you:§r no ceramic UO2 (so the metal has to climb back through conversion), no cladding hulls for hull recovery, and §9no Nuclear Waste Water§r. That is the whole argument for the Canyon.

§5THE COOLING POND§r §8- Decay Warehouse§r
Depleted rods and assemblies go in and come out as their §9cooled§r form, on a real half-life. Four grades, rods and assemblies, eight recipes.

§5THE PUREX CANYON§r §8- new multiblock, IV§r
  §9circuit 1§r §2cooled fuel + Nitric Acid  ->  Dissolver Liquor + Cladding Hulls + that grade's own return§r
  §9circuit 3§r§2 6,000 L Dissolver Liquor + 2,000 L TBP  ->  4x Ceramic UO2 + 1x PuO2 + Lead + 2,000 L Nuclear Waste Water§r
The uranium oxide goes §9straight back into the ceramic route§r (Pellets, Rods, Bundles). The plutonium dioxide is the §1only§r source of the MOX blend.

§5THE UNCOOLED RUSH§r §8- PUREX Canyon, circuit 2§r
 §2 1x Depleted Fuel Assembly STRAIGHT from the reactor + 6,000 L Nitric Acid  ->  4x Ceramic UO2 + Lead + 2x Hulls + 2,000 L Nuclear Waste Water§r
  §8Half as much acid again as the cooled route (4,000 L). A single depleted rod takes 2,000 L.§r
  §cNo plutonium.§r §8Skipping the pond costs you the element that needed the wait - which is exactly the trade a real reprocessor makes.§r

[note]§1No pond yet?§r If you already have a pile of depleted fuel and no Decay Warehouse, the Canyon ALONE clears it on circuit 2. You only need the pond if you want plutonium, which means only if you want MOX.[/note]

§5HULL RECOVERY§r §8- LCR, EV§r
 §2 4x Cladding Hull + 1,000 L Hydrofluoric Acid  ->  1x Zircaloy-4 Ingot + 1x Zirconium Dust§r
  §8Zircaloy is expensive and the hulls are most of what a bundle weighs.§r

[note]§1Nuclear Waste Water has two producers, and this one is controllable.§r The reactor itself makes it: while the silo is generating it puts out §9one litre per live pillar per tick§r through its own Output Hatch - about§8 201 L/t on a full tier-5 plant§r - which is a flood you cannot throttle and can only get while the plant is running. The Canyon's two dissolving recipes give you§2 2,000 L a batch§r on demand instead, out of the fuel you already burned. Both feed the same Distillation Tower recipe:§2 8,000 L -> Small Pile of Tantalum Dust + 7,200 L Distilled Water§r.[/note]

[note]That distilled water is not a rounding error: it is §9the bottom rung of the fuel ladder§r. A closed reprocessing loop pays part of its own reconversion water bill.[/note]
